ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Providers Under Review for Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the review process of nearly 6,000 Medicaid providers in Minnesota and potential implications for healthcare in the state.
questions: What are the criteria for review?

ideas.insight: This story could explore the specifics of the review process and what it means for healthcare in Minnesota.
